title: Mulukhiyah Pilaf
description: A flavorful Middle Eastern-inspired pilaf dish featuring the unique mulukhiyah leafy green. This recipe is a great way to experience the rich flavors of the Middle East.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add minced garlic and sauté for an additional minute.
Add chopped mulukhiyah and cook until wilted.
Add pilaf and stir to combine with mulukhiyah.
Gradually add aerated water, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon juice.
